get.description: Contains historical stock split and reverse split events for US equities with historical adjustment factors for price normalization.

parameters.description: Stock symbol for the company that executed the split
parameters.name: ticker

parameters.description: Filter equal to any of the values. Multiple values can be specified by using a comma separated list.
parameters.name: ticker.any_of

parameters.description: Filter greater than the value.
parameters.name: ticker.gt

parameters.description: Filter greater than or equal to the value.
parameters.name: ticker.gte

parameters.description: Filter less than the value.
parameters.name: ticker.lt

parameters.description: Filter less than or equal to the value.
parameters.name: ticker.lte

parameters.description: Date when the stock split takes effect. The adjustment is applied overnight. On the prior trading day, the post-market session is the last session that shows pre-split prices. On the execution date, all trading is already adjusted for the split. This includes the pre-market session. Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.
parameters.name: execution_date

parameters.description: Filter greater than the value. Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.
parameters.name: execution_date.gt

parameters.description: Filter greater than or equal to the value. Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.
parameters.name: execution_date.gte

parameters.description: Filter less than the value. Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.
parameters.name: execution_date.lt

parameters.description: Filter less than or equal to the value. Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.
parameters.name: execution_date.lte

parameters.description: Classification of the share-change event. Possible values include: forward_split (share count increases), reverse_split (share count decreases), stock_dividend (shares issued as a dividend)
parameters.name: adjustment_type

parameters.description: Filter equal to any of the values. Multiple values can be specified by using a comma separated list.
parameters.name: adjustment_type.any_of

parameters.description: Limit the maximum number of results returned. Defaults to '100' if not specified. The maximum allowed limit is '5000'.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: A comma separated list of sort columns. For each column, append '.asc' or '.desc' to specify the sort direction. The sort column defaults to 'execution_date' if not specified. The sort order defaults to 'desc' if not specified.
parameters.name: sort

next_url.description: If present, this value can be used to fetch the next page.

request_id.description: A request id assigned by the server.

adjustment_type.description: Classification of the share-change event. Possible values include: forward_split (share count increases), reverse_split (share count decreases), stock_dividend (shares issued as a dividend)

execution_date.description: Date when the stock split takes effect. The adjustment is applied overnight. On the prior trading day, the post-market session is the last session that shows pre-split prices. On the execution date, all trading is already adjusted for the split. This includes the pre-market session.

historical_adjustment_factor.description: Cumulative adjustment factor used to offset split effects on historical prices. To adjust a historical price for splits: for a price on date D, find the first split whose `execution_date` is after date D and multiply the unadjusted price by the `historical_adjustment_factor`.

id.description: Unique identifier for each stock split event

split_from.description: Denominator of the split ratio (old shares)

split_to.description: Numerator of the split ratio (new shares)

ticker.description: Stock symbol for the company that executed the split

status.description: The status of this request's response.

error.description: A message describing the source of the error.

request_id.description: A request id assigned by the server.

status.description: The status of this request's response.

get.description: Contains historical dividend payment records for US stocks with split-adjusted amounts and historical adjustment factors for price normalization.

parameters.description: Stock symbol for the company issuing the dividend
parameters.name: ticker

parameters.description: Filter equal to any of the values. Multiple values can be specified by using a comma separated list.
parameters.name: ticker.any_of

parameters.description: Filter greater than the value.
parameters.name: ticker.gt

parameters.description: Filter greater than or equal to the value.
parameters.name: ticker.gte

parameters.description: Filter less than the value.
parameters.name: ticker.lt

parameters.description: Filter less than or equal to the value.
parameters.name: ticker.lte

parameters.description: Date when the stock begins trading without the dividend value Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.
parameters.name: ex_dividend_date

parameters.description: Filter greater than the value. Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.
parameters.name: ex_dividend_date.gt

parameters.description: Filter greater than or equal to the value. Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.
parameters.name: ex_dividend_date.gte

parameters.description: Filter less than the value. Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.
parameters.name: ex_dividend_date.lt

parameters.description: Filter less than or equal to the value. Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.
parameters.name: ex_dividend_date.lte

parameters.description: How many times per year this dividend is expected to occur. A value of 0 means the distribution is non-recurring or irregular (e.g., special, supplemental, or a one-off dividend). Other possible values include 1 (annual), 2 (semi-annual), 3 (trimester), 4 (quarterly), 12 (monthly), 24 (bi-monthly), 52 (weekly), 104 (bi-weekly), and 365 (daily) depending on the issuer's declared or inferred payout cadence. Value must be an integer.
parameters.name: frequency

parameters.description: Filter greater than the value. Value must be an integer.
parameters.name: frequency.gt

parameters.description: Filter greater than or equal to the value. Value must be an integer.
parameters.name: frequency.gte

parameters.description: Filter less than the value. Value must be an integer.
parameters.name: frequency.lt

parameters.description: Filter less than or equal to the value. Value must be an integer.
parameters.name: frequency.lte

parameters.description: Classification describing the nature of this dividend's recurrence pattern: recurring (paid on a regular schedule), special (one-time or commemorative), supplemental (extra beyond the regular schedule), irregular (unpredictable or non-recurring), unknown (cannot be classified from available data)
parameters.name: distribution_type

parameters.description: Filter equal to any of the values. Multiple values can be specified by using a comma separated list.
parameters.name: distribution_type.any_of

parameters.description: Limit the maximum number of results returned. Defaults to '100' if not specified. The maximum allowed limit is '5000'.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: A comma separated list of sort columns. For each column, append '.asc' or '.desc' to specify the sort direction. The sort column defaults to 'ticker' if not specified. The sort order defaults to 'asc' if not specified.
parameters.name: sort

next_url.description: If present, this value can be used to fetch the next page.

request_id.description: A request id assigned by the server.

cash_amount.description: Original dividend amount per share in the specified currency

currency.description: Currency code for the dividend payment (e.g., USD, CAD)

declaration_date.description: Date when the company officially announced the dividend

distribution_type.description: Classification describing the nature of this dividend's recurrence pattern: recurring (paid on a regular schedule), special (one-time or commemorative), supplemental (extra beyond the regular schedule), irregular (unpredictable or non-recurring), unknown (cannot be classified from available data)

ex_dividend_date.description: Date when the stock begins trading without the dividend value

frequency.description: How many times per year this dividend is expected to occur. A value of 0 means the distribution is non-recurring or irregular (e.g., special, supplemental, or a one-off dividend). Other possible values include 1 (annual), 2 (semi-annual), 3 (trimester), 4 (quarterly), 12 (monthly), 24 (bi-monthly), 52 (weekly), 104 (bi-weekly), and 365 (daily) depending on the issuer's declared or inferred payout cadence.

historical_adjustment_factor.description: Cumulative adjustment factor used to offset dividend effects on historical prices. To adjust a historical price for dividends: for a price on date D, find the first dividend whose `ex_dividend_date` is after date D and multiply the price by that dividend's `historical_adjustment_factor`.

id.description: Unique identifier for each dividend record

pay_date.description: Date when the dividend payment is distributed to shareholders

record_date.description: Date when shareholders must be on record to be eligible for the dividend payment

split_adjusted_cash_amount.description: Dividend amount adjusted for stock splits that occurred after the dividend was paid, expressed on a current share basis

ticker.description: Stock symbol for the company issuing the dividend

status.description: The status of this request's response.

error.description: A message describing the source of the error.

request_id.description: A request id assigned by the server.

status.description: The status of this request's response.

get.description: Query all ticker symbols which are supported by Massive. This API currently includes Stocks/Equities, Indices, Forex, and Crypto.

parameters.description:
Specify a ticker symbol.
Defaults to empty string which queries all tickers.
parameters.name: ticker

parameters.description:
Specify the type of the tickers. Find the types that we support via our [Ticker Types API](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/tickers/ticker-types).
Defaults to empty string which queries all types.
parameters.name: type

parameters.description: Filter by market type. By default all markets are included.
parameters.name: market

parameters.description:
Specify the asset's primary exchange Market Identifier Code (MIC) according to [ISO 10383](https://www.iso20022.org/market-identifier-codes).
Defaults to empty string which queries all exchanges.
parameters.name: exchange

parameters.description:
Specify the CUSIP code of the asset you want to search for. Find more information about CUSIP codes [at their website](https://www.cusip.com/identifiers.html#/CUSIP).
Defaults to empty string which queries all CUSIPs.

Note: Although you can query by CUSIP, due to legal reasons we do not return the CUSIP in the response.
parameters.name: cusip

parameters.description:
Specify the CIK of the asset you want to search for. Find more information about CIK codes [at their website](https://www.sec.gov/edgar/searchedgar/cik.htm).
Defaults to empty string which queries all CIKs.
parameters.name: cik

parameters.description:
Specify a point in time to retrieve tickers available on that date.
Defaults to the most recent available date.
parameters.name: date

parameters.description: Search for terms within the ticker and/or company name.
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Specify if the tickers returned should be actively traded on the queried date. Default is true.
parameters.name: active

parameters.description: Range by ticker.
parameters.name: ticker.gte

parameters.description: Range by ticker.
parameters.name: ticker.gt

parameters.description: Range by ticker.
parameters.name: ticker.lte

parameters.description: Range by ticker.
parameters.name: ticker.lt

parameters.description: Order results based on the `sort` field.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: Limit the number of results returned, default is 100 and max is 1000.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Sort field used for ordering.
parameters.name: sort

count.description: The total number of results for this request.

next_url.description: If present, this value can be used to fetch the next page of data.

request_id.description: A request id assigned by the server.

results.description:
An array of tickers that match your query.

Note: Although you can query by CUSIP, due to legal reasons we do not return the CUSIP in the response.

active.description: Whether or not the asset is actively traded. False means the asset has been delisted.

base_currency_name.description: The name of the currency that this asset is priced against.

base_currency_symbol.description: The ISO 4217 code of the currency that this asset is priced against.

cik.description: The CIK number for this ticker. Find more information [here](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_Index_Key).

composite_figi.description: The composite OpenFIGI number for this ticker. Find more information [here](https://www.openfigi.com/about/figi)

currency_name.description: The name of the currency that this asset is traded with.

currency_symbol.description: The ISO 4217 code of the currency that this asset is traded with.

delisted_utc.description: The last date that the asset was traded.

last_updated_utc.description: The information is accurate up to this time.

market.description: The market type of the asset.

name.description: The name of the asset. For stocks/equities this will be the companies registered name. For crypto/fx this will be the name of the currency or coin pair.

primary_exchange.description: The ISO code of the primary listing exchange for this asset.

share_class_figi.description: The share Class OpenFIGI number for this ticker. Find more information [here](https://www.openfigi.com/about/figi)

ticker.description: The exchange symbol that this item is traded under.

type.description: The type of the asset. Find the types that we support via our [Ticker Types API](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/tickers/ticker-types).

status.description: The status of this request's response.

401.description: Unauthorized - Check our API Key and account status
